global_claim_boundary: A prose proof or Python regression test does not count as Lean mechanization. OPEN_FORMALIZATION is an owned assurance task, not a hidden defect.

obligations.title: Path quotient preserves verified endpoint reachability
obligations.statement: If ~ is an endpoint-preserving equivalence congruence on verified finite paths, existence of a quotient morphism from x to y is equivalent to existence of a verified representative path from x to y.
obligations.next_epistemic_cut: Lean compiles the theorem without sorry/admit/axiom escape hatches

obligations.title: Verified-map expansion monotonicity
obligations.statement: Under frozen edge semantics and costs, adding verified transitions cannot invalidate an existing verified route; for a minimization cost algebra the best known route value cannot worsen.
dependencies: choose scoped cost algebra theorem variant
obligations.next_epistemic_cut: Lean checks route-existence monotonicity and the registered scalar/Pareto specialization claimed in the paper

obligations.title: Operator-basis expansion monotonicity
obligations.statement: If Omega is a subset of Omega' and all old transition semantics remain unchanged, every state reachable under Omega is reachable under Omega'.
obligations.next_epistemic_cut: Lean checks the inclusion theorem under explicit frozen-semantics assumptions

obligations.title: Well-founded local descent terminates inside a certified basin
obligations.statement: If every non-goal solvable state in a registered basin has a verified legal successor with strictly smaller rank in a well-founded order and every reachable minimal-rank state is a goal, repeated policy application terminates at a goal.
obligations.next_epistemic_cut: Lean checks finite termination and goal reachability without assuming the desired conclusion

obligations.title: Map/geometry/search noninterference with theorem authority
obligations.statement: If routing updates have no constructor/write path into authority-bearing theorem state and authority changes only through the registered proof/specification/trust gate, then map, quotient, geometry and navigation updates cannot promote or refute a theorem.
obligations.next_epistemic_cut: Lean type/model proves routing-only transitions preserve mathematical authority projection

obligations.title: Exact navigation quotient preserves target reachability under two-way simulation/lifting
obligations.statement: Under target-label preservation plus the registered two-way simulation/route-lifting assumptions, concrete target reachability is equivalent to abstract target reachability.
obligations.next_epistemic_cut: Lean checks both reachability directions under exactly the assumptions advertised

obligations.title: Oracle-distance trivialization of existence-only local geometry
obligations.statement: For every finite connected unweighted graph and fixed target, exact graph distance is a natural-number-valued local descent function: every non-target vertex has a neighbor at distance one smaller, so greedy descent reaches the target.
obligations.next_epistemic_cut: Lean checks the trivialization theorem, supporting the non-vacuity boundary in Paper V

obligations.title: Budget truncation need not preserve triangle inequality
obligations.statement: There exists a three-state finite path-cost system and budget B such that independently truncating distances above B to infinity violates triangle inequality, so budget-feasible control is not automatically an intrinsic metric.
obligations.next_epistemic_cut: Lean checks the explicit counterexample used to justify separating intrinsic geometry from budget
